description: West Bengal vs Odisha, five rounds of official data. Final score: West Bengal 3, Odisha 2.

Class 9-12 enrolment ratio, 2024-25: West Bengal 81.2%, Odisha 66.8% (West Bengal ahead; gross ratio, can pass 100 · 2024-25 · higher is better)
Mothers with 4+ pregnancy check-ups: West Bengal 64.5%, Odisha 73.6% (Odisha ahead; mothers, 4+ visits · 2023-24 · higher is better)
Infant deaths per 1,000 births, 2023: West Bengal 17.0, Odisha 30.0 (West Bengal ahead; per 1,000 births · 2023 · lower is better)
Babies breastfed within 1 hour: West Bengal 50.0%, Odisha 60.9% (Odisha ahead; children under 3 · 2023-24 · higher is better)
Adequate diet, babies 6-23 months: West Bengal 28.3%, Odisha 14.9% (West Bengal ahead; babies 6-23 months · 2023-24 · higher is better)

Closing map: Class 9-12 enrolment, every state (West Bengal 3 · Odisha 2 · India 67.6%). Gross enrolment ratio, 2024-25 (UDISE+): pupils of any age over the age group. Both states outlined. The table shows how much, not why.
